abstract: AIM: Oophorectomy performed in children is extremely uncommon. We aimed to investigate the disease pattern and the association between the underlying pathology and the clinical presentation among those patients who had their ovaries removed in their childhood. METHODS: A retrospective study was performed on 41 consecutive children who underwent oophorectomy in a tertiary referral centre in the period between June 1995 and May 2008. RESULTS: The median age was 11 years, ranged from 11 weeks to 15 years at the time of surgery. The primary presentations were acute lower abdominal pain (n= 20), progressive abdominal distension or abdominal mass (n= 13), chronic abdominal pain (n= 3), irregular menses (n= 1), antenatal diagnosis (n= 3) and incidental finding (n= 1). Ultrasound examination was performed in 31 patients and positive findings of ovarian pathology were found in all but one examination. Twenty cases of ovarian torsion were confirmed intra-operatively. Patients presenting with acute abdominal pain were more likely to have torsion than other presentations (P < 0.01). Non-neoplastic conditions and ovarian neoplasms were found in 11 and 30 patients, respectively. The most common neoplasm was mature teratoma (52%). Malignant neoplasms included immature teratoma (n= 3), dysgerminoma (n= 1), mixed dysgerminoma + yolk sac tumour (n= 2), yolk sac tumour (n= 2) and juvenile granulose cell tumour (n= 1). Malignant neoplasms were found to have more chronic presentation and less torsion than benign pathologies (P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: Although ovarian pathology is uncommon in children, a girl presenting with acute lower abdominal pain or progressive abdominal distension should raise the suspicion and prompt immediate investigation to rule out ovarian torsion or ovarian neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 目的：小児における卵巣摘除術は極めてまれである。本研究では、幼少期に卵巣を摘出された患者の疾患パターンと、基礎病理と臨床像の関連を調べた。方法：三次紹介施設で1995年6月から2008年5月までに卵巣摘除術を受けた連続41例を後方視的に検討した。結果：年齢中央値は11歳で、手術時年齢は11週から15歳であった。主な初発症状は急性下腹部痛(20例)、進行性の腹部膨満または腹部腫瘤(13例)、慢性腹痛(3例)、月経不順(1例)、出生前診断(3例)、偶発的所見(1例)であった。31例に超音波検査が施行され、1例を除く全例で卵巣病変の陽性所見が得られた。術中に卵巣捻転が20例で確認された。急性腹痛で来院した患者は他の初発症状の患者より捻転を生じやすかった(P<0.01)。非腫瘍性病変は11例、卵巣腫瘍は30例で認められた。最も多い腫瘍は成熟奇形腫(52%)であった。悪性腫瘍には未熟奇形腫(3例)、ディスジャーミノーマ(1例)、ディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合型(2例)、卵黄嚢腫瘍(2例)、若年性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍(1例)が含まれた。悪性腫瘍は良性疾患より慢性の経過を示し、捻転は少なかった(P<0.05)。結論：小児の卵巣病変はまれであるが、急性下腹部痛または進行性腹部膨満を呈する女児では、卵巣捻転または卵巣腫瘍を除外するため、速やかな検査を行うべきである。
